title: Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Partnerships
description:
Circa:


Salary is competitive.


The Royal Society of Chemistry is a not\-for\-profit organisation whose mission is to advance chemical sciences. As a not\-for\-profit publisher, we reinvest surplus funds back into the global scientific community, supporting our purpose to help the chemical science community to create a future that is more open and more equal. We work closely with public authorities, universities and schools.


We are looking for an experienced Leader in publishing to join us as a **Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Strategic Partnerships** . In this role you will be a Growth Accelerator in identifying new opportunities and partnerships with our key external stakeholders. You will continue building and developing strong relationships with government and policy bodies, ONOS, Inflibnet, private and public universities across the region to strengthen our existing position in the market.


In this role you will be the one who will develop and deliver unified community engagement and partnership strategy across India and South Asia, helping to expand the reach, visibility and impact of the Royal Society of Chemistry's activities.


As the strategic lead for community outreach, advocacy and institutional partnerships, you will bring together engagement activities into a coordinated, year\-round programme focused on delivering measurable outcomes and long\-term impact. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Memberships, Sales and Marketing to align engagement initiatives with organisational priorities and increase awareness and use of RSC content and services, while maximising opportunities through national initiatives such as ONOS.


This is a very exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong understanding of scientific publishing, research and higher education landscape across India and South Asia, including open science, open access, research funding and science policy.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set and own the India and South Asia community, advocacy and strategic partnerships strategy, defining regional priorities, maintaining a forward roadmap and aligning activity, resource and investment to RSC’s global purpose and long\-term goals.
* Strengthen RSC’s position in ONOS, INFLIBNET, open access and APC revenue opportunities by building priority partnerships, supporting platform and journal adoption, and working with Head of Sales on pilots, lighthouse wins and monetised partnerships.
* Oversee the planning and delivery of major events and engagement activity, including setting agendas with partners and briefing or involving RSC Senior Leadership for priority activity such as sustainability and CRSI\-related events.
* Create a collaborative team environment that encourages open communication, knowledge sharing and joined\-up delivery across internal and external partners.
* Translate global and regional priorities for open science, open access, sustainable chemistry, inclusion, research culture and scientific impact into clear plans, flagship activity and workstreams with defined owners, timelines and governance.
* Own senior engagement with research communities through structured stakeholder mapping, targeted programmes and relationship management across PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, early career researchers, authors, reviewers, academics, institutions and senior scientific leaders.
* Set the regional policy and sector insight agenda by monitoring developments across science, research, higher education, publishing and the funder ecosystem, assessing implications for RSC and producing clear recommendations, briefings and internal updates.
* Build and steward strategic relationships with government, funders, academic institutions, research networks, innovation clusters, startups, incubators, sector bodies and other priority partners through clear engagement plans and partnership objectives.
* Set the strategic engagement approach for librarians, consortia, academic influencers and state and central universities, strengthening awareness, adoption and effective use of RSC platforms, products, journals and books across priority institutions.
* Communicate priorities, expectations and decisions clearly, ensuring direct reports and stakeholders understand responsibilities, objectives and how their work contributes to the wider strategy.
* Work with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver major outreach, advocacy, partnership and market development programmes, including sustainability, DEI, women in chemistry, open science and open access activity.
* Ensure programmes are well governed and properly resourced through clear budgets, risk controls, supplier oversight, decision governance, delivery reviews, operational delivery standards and post\-programme evaluation.
* Act as the regional point of influence for community, advocacy and partnership insight, helping Editorial, Sales, Membership, Marketing and relevant Global Impact Group teams align priorities and delivery.

**Requirements:**

* Degree or Master’s level education in science, or equivalent practical experience, with significant senior\-level experience in community engagement, advocacy, policy, partnerships or scientific outreach.
* Strong understanding of the Indian and South Asian research, higher education, science policy, funder, publishing, open access, open science or chemistry community landscape.
* Proven ability to set direction, shape strategy and lead complex regional engagement, advocacy or partnership plans.
* Experience building senior relationships with academic leaders, policymakers, funders, government bodies, librarians, research institutions and sector partners.
* Strong policy judgement, communication, advocacy and influencing skills, including clear recommendations for senior audiences.
* Experience leading major programmes, including budgets, governance, procurement, supplier oversight, risk management, evaluation, impact reporting and ROI.
* Commercial awareness, including business case development, value for money, revenue growth opportunities, cost recovery, sponsorship or co\-funding where relevant.

At the Royal Society of Chemistry, we support flexibility and offer hybrid working, which means our teams come together when they need to collaborate.
 

Although this role is contractually based at our Delhi office, and therefore you will have the opportunity to work mostly from any other location in India, as agreed with your line manager. Applicants should be aware that there is an expectation that employees will attend our Delhi office once a month. Please be aware that in this role you are expected to travel across India for events or meetings with our external partners.

description:
**Designation**\- Brand Marketing Manager
  

  

**Experience** \- 5 Years
  

  

**Position Description** – Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.
  

In the capacity of a Brand Marketing Manager, you will ensure the efficient execution of business plans to meet future brand expectations and targets. You will also take part in the development of short\-term tactical Brand Management marketing plans. You will ensure brand integrity by guiding efforts across multiple channels and functions and support the development and execution of offline, digital, and paid social advertising programs for the business.
  

The role entails the management of media campaigns from the beginning to the end and is also responsible for the execution across all media channels inclusive of TV, Radio, Digital, Print, and Paid Social. The Brand Marketing Manager reports directly to the Director\- Womennovator.
  

  

**The Impact You'll Make in this Role** \-
  

  

**Strategy :** You will play part in the development of the brand marketing strategies in order to establish strategic direction and program positioning. In this capacity, the Brand Marketing Manager, you will develop marketing partnerships with media partners, and other external partners in an attempt to broaden the reach of the business’s brand messaging.
  

You will also play part in the development and execution of paid social programs on advertising platforms inclusive of Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, and Twitter etc. along with supporting the brand’s paid media programs. At this capacity, you will contribute to the development and execution of all online/offline events, promotions for the business/brand.
  

  

**Management:** You will play a managerial role in the production process for all offline marketing materials, for example, project timelines, and so forth. You will be tasked with the maintenance of the lower department’s operational production budget, ensuring that there is a continuous effective and economical allocation of resources. You will also supervises multiple external agencies in developing creative advertising, high\-impact promotions, and media planning,event sponsorship.
  

You will additionally manage media timelines and executes plans across all media channels, that is, TV, Social, Radio, and Print etc. you will effectively supervisethe junior marketing staff/team, managing workflow, providing direction, and overseeing constant skill development. You will strike a balance in ensuring all branding and key information strategies are in line with overall business strategy without compromising the brand’s integrity.
  

  

**Collaboration:** You will work closely with Director, in reviewing and approving all branded elements for advertising and launch materials inclusive of printed collateral, product packaging, online assets, launch toolkits, product logos, and videos etc..
  

In this collaboration, he/she also provides feedback and insight on the performance of program campaigns and relays them for further strategic development and solution formulation. You will serves as a collaborative partner and liaison between all internal product departments in ensuring integrated campaigns and cohesive strategies. Youwill also be tasked with collaborating with external partners in ensuring that all media plans are aligned with the business’s values and goals, are executed on\-time and on\-budget.
  

  

**Analytics:** You will also play an analytical role where you will conduct research and analyses, translating campaign performance into communication documents and reports, which are distributed to management and key stakeholders. Some of these documents are marketing briefs, competitive analyses, campaign recap decks, and so forth.
  

At this capacity, You will track spending on all media campaigns for the purpose of ensuring that brand marketing efforts always stay within the allocated budget. Here, you will actualize cost reports per project at the completion of each brand marketing campaign. You will prepare account management, expenditure, progress, and other related reports. Additionally, you will review targeted spends and make real\-time adjustments to optimize brand marketing campaign performance.
  

  

**Knowledge and Opportunity:** You will also conduct regular and consistent research and keep the business and the brand marketing department informed on best practices and the latest trends in brand marketing that ensure that the business does not lag behind of its competition and also in order to provide growth opportunity for the brand by capitalizing on the acquisition potential that alternative branding strategies/approaches may hold.
  

At this capacity, you will ensure that the product/service maintains a consistent tone that is relevant to the business’s brand and the audience, solidifying the brand identity by ensuring consistent, on\-time and accurate development, deliveryfor each brand marketing campaign.
  

  

**Other Duties:** You will also performs other tasks as designated by the Director.
  

  

**To set you up for success in this role from day one, Womennovator is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:**  

  

  

* MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing (Completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university


* Five (5\) combined years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing


* Three (3\) years people leadership experience


* Strong communications (written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal) skills, including tact, diplomacy, and ability to influence and navigate across a diverse and complex organization.


* Highly proficient in Ms Word, PowerPoint, and Ms Excel


  

**Age:** Preferably below 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of application
